title: White Sun
description: Two brothers divided by Nepal’s civil war have to carry their father’s body down a steep mountain path together.

title: A Road to a Village
description: A new road reaches a Rai village. A basket weaver sees his livelihood threatened while his son is fascinated by what the road brings.

title: Kagbeni
description: A wish-granting paw finds its way into a Mustang village. Each wish comes with a price.

title: Pashupati Prasad
description: A young man comes to Kathmandu to repay his father’s debt and tries to stay honest among people who take advantage of him.

title: The Red Suitcase
description: A pickup driver takes a mysterious delivery from Kathmandu airport to a mountain village. The trip grows stranger with every mile.

title: Bulbul
description: A Kathmandu tempo driver gets a chance at romance while juggling work and family responsibilities.

title: Loot
description: A Kathmandu bank job brings together men who each think they’re the smartest person in the room.

title: Shambhala
description: After her husband disappears, Pema crosses the high Himalayas with her monk brother-in-law to find him.

title: The Black Hen
description: During a ceasefire in Nepal’s civil war, two boys in a mountain village go looking for a missing hen.

title: Lunana: A Yak in the Classroom
description: A reluctant teacher walks for days to reach a mountain school, then has to figure out what he can offer the children there.

title: The Monk and the Gun
description: As Bhutan rehearses its first election, a lama sends a young monk looking for guns. An American collector wants the same antique rifle.

title: Hema Hema: Sing Me a Song While I Wait
description: Masked strangers gather in a Bhutanese forest for a ritual that lets them shed their identities and act on their desires.

title: Honeygiver Among the Dogs
description: A detective investigating a missing nun meets a woman the villagers are convinced is a demon.

title: Travellers & Magicians
description: A Bhutanese official dreaming of America shares the road with a monk who tells him a story about a young man led astray by desire.

title: Jinpa
description: A trucker runs over a sheep on the Tibetan Plateau, then gives a lift to a stranger intent on revenge.

title: Balloon
description: An unexpected pregnancy puts a Tibetan family’s beliefs about rebirth up against the question of who gets to decide what happens next.

title: Ala Changso
description: A woman sets out for Lhasa on foot. The journey brings her family’s grief and long-held secrets to the surface.

title: Milarepa
description: The young man who will become a Tibetan yogi turns to sorcery against the people who wronged his family. Filmed in Spiti.

title: Manjhi: The Mountain Man
description: After a personal tragedy, a man in Bihar spends years cutting a path through a rocky ridge by hand.

title: Ankhon Dekhi
description: A man in Old Delhi decides he’ll believe only what he sees for himself. His joint family has to live with the consequences.

title: Ship of Theseus
description: A photographer, a monk and a stockbroker come up against questions of identity, bodily autonomy and what people owe each other.

title: Udaan
description: An aspiring teenage writer returns to Jamshedpur, where his father already has his future planned for him.

title: Iqbal
description: A deaf village fast bowler dreams of playing for India and finds a coach who can help him train for a chance.

title: Sonchiriya
description: Outlaws on the run face a test of their own code when a woman and a girl need their help.

title: Lakshya
description: An aimless young man joins the army and finds a sense of purpose in the mountains of Kargil.

title: Tumbbad
description: A man returns to his ancestral village for a buried fortune and learns what it costs to keep coming back for more.

title: Fire in the Mountains
description: In Munsiyari, a mother carries her son down the mountain for treatment while saving to build a road.

title: Pahuna: The Little Visitors
description: Three children separated from their parents have to make do on their own in the hills of Sikkim.

title: Village Rockstars
description: A girl in rural Assam dreams of owning a real guitar and starting a rock band.

title: Kanchenjungha
description: A wealthy family walks through misty Darjeeling while quietly negotiating a young woman’s future.

title: Vihir
description: Two teenage cousins are inseparable. An ordinary family visit becomes a reflection on how a young person makes sense of death.

title: Dweepa
description: The monsoon arrives, a dam fills, and a woman named Nagi fights to hold on to her home.

title: Merku Thodarchi Malai
description: A cardamom porter in the Western Ghats makes the same punishing walk for work and dreams of a small plot of land.

title: Kadaisi Vivasayi
description: An elderly farmer keeps tending his land even when a case involving dead peacocks lands him in court.

title: Manjummel Boys
description: A holiday in Kodaikanal becomes a desperate rescue when one of the friends falls deep into a cave. Based on a real incident.

title: The Summit: A Chronicle of Stones
description: An army survey team and a local guide risk their lives to map a peak in the Japanese Alps.

title: Sword of the Stranger
description: A wandering swordsman protects a boy and his dog from the warriors pursuing them across feudal Japan.

title: Ikiru
description: A dying civil servant fights through layers of bureaucracy to do one worthwhile thing with the time he has left.

title: Harakiri
description: A masterless samurai arrives at a powerful clan’s estate and lays bare how its leaders wield their code of honor.

title: Ghost in the Shell
description: A cyborg officer hunts a hacker in a world where memories can be rewritten. The case makes her question what constitutes a self.

title: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter… and Spring
description: A boy grows up at a Buddhist temple on a lake. Each season takes him into a new stage of life.

title: The Cord of Life
description: An electronic musician takes his mother, whose memory is fading, back to the Inner Mongolian grasslands she remembers.

title: The Light Thief
description: A village electrician gives poor neighbors power they can’t afford and runs up against influential men with plans of their own.

title: Where Is the Friend’s House?
description: A boy crosses the hills to return a classmate’s notebook before his friend gets in trouble at school.

title: The Eight Mountains
description: Two boys meet in an Alpine village. Their lives take different paths, but they keep finding their way back to each other in the mountains.

title: North Face
description: In 1936, two teams race to climb the Eiger’s north face. A turn in the weather makes getting down the harder task.

title: Solaris
description: A psychologist reaches a space station where the planet below seems to give the crew’s painful memories physical form.

title: The Velvet Queen
description: A wildlife photographer and a writer wait and watch on the Tibetan Plateau, hoping for a glimpse of a snow leopard.

title: The Summit of the Gods
description: A Japanese photojournalist spots a camera that could rewrite Everest history and follows its trail to a reclusive climber.

title: Touching the Void
description: A disastrous descent in the Peruvian Andes leaves Joe Simpson and Simon Yates facing a decision that will define both their lives.

title: Meru
description: Three climbers return to the Garhwal Himalayas for another attempt at the formidable Shark’s Fin on Mount Meru.

title: The Straight Story
description: An elderly man drives a lawn mower from Iowa to Wisconsin to see his ailing brother.

title: Utama
description: An elderly Quechua couple face a long drought in the Bolivian highlands and a decision about the life they’ve built.

title: Embrace of the Serpent
description: An Amazonian shaman guides two scientists in search of a sacred plant. Their expeditions are decades apart.

title: Sherpa
description: An avalanche reshapes the 2014 Everest season, seen through the Sherpas whose work makes the climbs possible.

title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
description: A defiant kid and his grumpy foster uncle get lost in the New Zealand bush and set off a national manhunt.
